en.headline: Observatory expects higher coastal water levels this evening
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said astronomical high tide and the northeast monsoon may raise water levels tonight, with possible minor flooding in some low-lying areas, while mornings and nights stay cool.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a special weather tip on Tuesday warning that coastal water levels are expected to be slightly higher than normal this evening under the combined influence of astronomical high tide and the northeast monsoon.

Some low-lying areas may experience minor flooding. The Observatory also said mornings and nights will be cool over the next couple of days, with urban minimum temperatures around 16 to 17 degrees and lower in the New Territories.
Residents in low-lying coastal areas were advised to take precautions against the higher water levels. The northeast monsoon continues to affect the coast of Guangdong.

zh.headline: 天文台料今晚沿岸水位偏高 低窪地區或輕微水浸
zh.dek: 天文台表示受天文大潮及東北季候風影響，今晚沿岸水位較正常稍高，部分低窪地區可能出現輕微水浸，早晚清涼。
body: 香港天文台周二發出特別天氣提示，受天文大潮及東北季候風的共同影響，預料今晚沿岸水位較正常稍高。
部分低窪地區可能出現輕微水浸。天文台同時表示，未來一兩日早晚清涼，市區最低氣溫約16至17度，新界再低一兩度。
天文台提醒低窪沿岸地區居民留意水位變化。東北季候風正影響廣東沿岸。
